entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates registration and may request DRX parameters.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network for registration procedure.

entities.name: Requested DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Information element used by UE to indicate desired DRX parameters to network.

entities.name: UE wants to use or change DRX parameters
entities.description: Condition where UE desires to utilize or modify its specific DRX parameters.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the Requested DRX parameters IE when UE wants to use or change DRX parameters.
The inclusion of Requested DRX parameters IE is guarded by the condition that UE wants to use or change DRX parameters.
UE triggers the condition for DRX parameter change based on its requirements.
